Daily Devotional

November 2

13 For he shall have judgment without mercy, that hath shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment. (James 2:13 KJV)

The bible in many places tells us that we will be judged as we have judged others (Matthew 7:1). Here it is making very clear that if we show no mercy to others, then we will get no mercy when God judges us. Jesus not only brought us Mercy, but also Grace. Mercy is not getting what we deserve and Grace is getting what we don’t deserve. In His atonement, Jesus brought us a wonderful gift of Grace in providing us with the gifts of healing, deliverance, prosperity and forgiveness of sins. Wow, and how can a Christian fail to give mercy to others, when God has showed us such marvelous mercy. A Christian, who has been truly born again, should always show mercy and love to others, as we have the fruit of the spirit living within us (Galatians 5:22-23). If you don’t show the fruit of being a little Christ, then you should question if you are truly born again.

Due to our sins against God, we all deserve to be sent to hell (Romans 3:23), and it is only the AGAPE type of God’s love that has caused Him to give us mercy instead of judgment. Since Adam sinned in the Garden of Eden (Genesis 3:6), all humans have been born with a sin nature, and we are born sinners for this reason, before we ever commit a sin of our own. It took the atonement of Jesus dying on the cross, to give us the forgiveness and mercy that we needed, so that we could be born again in the spirit, and become righteous in the sight of God. What a marvelous plan of redemption that God had, and what love that it demonstrated. We need to try and understand the love that God, the Father, has for us, in studying the Word of God, and getting to know Him (John 17:3). Just knowing about Him is not enough, but you need to KNOW Him, in an intimate way. Only then can you fully appreciate what He has done for you, by sending Jesus to die for us, to bring us back into relationship with Him. Praise God!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
